name: Black Diary
source:
The young woman wakes up in a town with no memory of how she got there. The town is deserted. She must find the one clue that can explain what is happening.

[From [url=https://lehxra.itch.io/black-diary]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年轻女子在一个小镇醒来，却不记得自己是如何到达那里的。小镇空无一人。她必须找到一条线索来解释正在发生的事情。

[来自[url=https://lehxra.itch.io/black-diary]Itch.io[/url]]
